plain.li: [lowmood] Tired of the work, tired of the cold, tired of myself.
[lowmood] Slept ten hours and woke up wanting ten more.
[lowmood] Cried a little after the lights went out. Quietly, in a room full of ears.
[lowmood] A bad day, and the barracks give you nowhere to put a bad day.
[rain] Rain on the roof all evening. I listened to it the way you'd listen to music, for want of any.
[rain] Too wet to go out, too dull to stay in. I went to bed at sundown.
[snow] Snow piled against the door in the night. The room never stood a chance.
[clear] Walked out past the fields with {OTHER_nameDef} on a clear evening and talked about what we'd lost to get here.
[clear] {OTHER_nameDef} and I sat on the wall in the last of the light and talked until the stars came out.
[rain] Stuck indoors by the rain with {OTHER_nameDef}, and we talked about everything we'd been putting off saying.
[lowmood] I was having a bad day, and {OTHER_nameDef} noticed, and sat down, and let me talk.
[lowmood] Told {OTHER_nameDef} how low I've been. Saying it out loud made it smaller.
[highmood] Laughed so much at supper my face hurt. The dining room does that to people.
[highmood] In a good mood all through supper. The room helped, and the company more.
[clear] Fine night, so half the colony was up late outside, and the other half was kept awake by them.
[clear] Not a cloud, not a breath of wind, and somehow still no sleep. Doors, all night.
[lowmood] Broken sleep on top of a bad week. I'm running on very little.
[clear] Supper outside on a fine evening. Everything tastes better with a clear sky over it.
[clear] We carried the table out into the sun at lunch. Good food, good light.
[highmood] Laughed through the whole meal. The food was good and so was everything else.
[highmood] A fine supper on a fine day. I couldn't ask for more, so I asked for seconds.
[hot] The heat outside came in at dusk and never left.
[lowmood] Hungry and low. Hard to say which came first today.
[lowmood] Didn't have the heart to go and ask for more. Went to bed hungry.
[lowmood] I've been low all week, and today {OTHER_nameDef} said one kind thing. It went a long way.
[lowmood] {OTHER_nameDef} told me I'm doing better than I think. Maybe I am.
[rain] Ate in the doorway to keep out of the rain. Half of me got wet anyway.
[rain] Rain dripping into the bowl on my knees. It made the soup go further, at least.
[highmood] Whistled all day. It's a good feeling, building something from the ground up.
[highmood] Everything went right today. Small things, but all of them.
[rain] Soaked through my coat in a minute. There isn't enough coat left to stop the rain.
[rain] My boots let the rain in and keep it there.
[highmood] Played until late and laughed most of the way through.
[highmood] A good mood and a good evening in the rec room. Those two go together.
[clear] Fine weather, and "{WISH}" done. I went and stood in the sun next to it.
[clear] Not a cloud in the sky, and the council came through. Good day.
[highmood] I was already in a good mood, and then "{WISH}" happened. Now I'm unbearable.
[highmood] Everything's going well, and "{WISH}" is part of it.
[promised] They promised "{WISH}", and here it is. I'll trust the next promise sooner.
[promised] A promise kept, and on time. I'm writing that down twice.
[petition] We asked together, and together we got it. Everyone who signed came to look.
[petition] The others who asked for "{WISH}" with me are as pleased as I am. More, maybe.
[forother] Someone asked for this on my behalf. I'll find them and thank them properly.
[forother] I didn't ask for it myself. Somebody else spoke up for me, and the council listened.
[repeat] Asked more than once, and this time it happened. Persistence, I suppose.
[repeat] I'd asked before and been passed over. Not this time.

blunt.li: [repeat] Should have happened the first time I asked. Still, done.

plain.li: [night] Couldn't sleep. Sat up with a candle and thought about {OTHER_nameDef}.
[night] The nights are the worst. That's when I remember {OTHER_nameDef} is gone.

warm.li: [spring] The first flowers are out. I picked some for {OTHER_nameDef}'s grave.
[spring] {OTHER_nameDef} loved this time of year. I planted something where {OTHER_pronoun} used to sit.

cheerful.li: [rain] Rain all day. {OTHER_nameDef} used to say it washed the colony clean. I'm trying to believe it.
[rain] Listened to the rain and remembered {OTHER_nameDef} dancing in it once. I smiled, then I didn't.

gloomy.li: [lowmood] {OTHER_nameDef} is gone, and the dark I've been in got darker.
[lowmood] I don't know how to carry this on top of everything else.

plain.li: [repeat] Asked again and heard nothing again. It's getting to be a habit, theirs and mine.
[winter] Winter's half gone and so is my patience. Nothing came of "{WISH}".
[winter] Cold days, and no answer. I'll stop hoping until the thaw.
[trusting] I was sure they'd get to it. They're usually good about these things.
[trusting] I'll give them the benefit of the doubt. They must have had a reason.
[forother] I asked on someone else's behalf, and now I have to tell them it came to nothing.
[forother] It wasn't my wish to begin with. Still, I'd asked, and I feel foolish now.

cheerful.li: [fall] Nothing came of it, but there are apples, so I'm not complaining.
[fall] Didn't happen. The harvest's good, though, and I'm counting that instead.

gloomy.li: [lowmood] Of course nothing came of it. Nothing has, lately.
[lowmood] I can't even be angry. I'm too tired for it.

plain.li: [trusting] I took them at their word. I won't be the first to do that again.
[trusting] I've always trusted the council. Tonight I'm not sure why.
[night] Can't sleep for thinking about it. They promised.
[night] Lay awake counting the days they had, and how many they used.
[doubtful] I had my doubts, and I let them talk me out of them.
[doubtful] I knew it, and I still hoped. That's on me.
[winter] They promised before the snows. The snows came and the promise didn't.
[winter] Cold outside, and colder in here since they broke their word.

gloomy.li: [winter] A promise broken in the dark half of the year. It fits.
[winter] Long cold nights to think about how they let me down.

plain.li: [doubtful] I didn't think they'd do it. I've been wrong before, and I'm glad to be wrong now.
[doubtful] Maybe I've been too hard on the council.
[trusting] They said they would, and they did. That's the council I know.
[trusting] I never doubted it. Well, once. Briefly.

warm.li: [winter] Even with the snow up to the door, they kept their promise. I won't forget it.
[winter] A cold season, and a warm thing done. Thank you, whoever did the work.

gloomy.li: [rain] Rain again. Promise kept, though, which is more than I can say for the weather.
[rain] Wet and dull. They kept their word, and that's the bright spot.

plain.li: [clear] Clear day, so we saw them coming a long way off. It didn't make the waiting easier.
[clear] Not a cloud all day. Strange to fight under a sky that pretty.
[clear] Good light for it, at least. We could see every one of them.
[spring] The raid came with the thaw. The ground was so soft we left deep prints all the way to the wall.
[summer] Fought in the long grass. I'm still pulling seeds out of my clothes.
[fall] They came at harvest, when every hand was in the fields. Half of us ran back with sickles.
[winter] Fought until the snow was trampled to slush. The stars were out by the time we stopped.

cheerful.li: [highmood] We beat them! I was in a good mood this morning and I refuse to let a raid change that.
[highmood] Raid's done, everyone's whole, and I'm still grinning.

gloomy.li: [lowmood] Another raid. I fought, and then I sat down and couldn't get up for a while.
[lowmood] They came, and I didn't care much whether I came back. I did.

plain.li: [repeat] Asked again, and no again. I'll find another way.
[repeat] They've said no to "{WISH}" twice now. I'm starting to take the hint.
[forother] I asked on someone else's behalf, and they said no. I'll be the one to break it to them.
[forother] Not even for me, and still refused. I hope they had a good reason.
[trusting] If the council says no, I'll accept it. They've earned that from me.
[trusting] Refused, but I trust they weighed it fairly.

warm.li: [trusting] They've been good to me before. One no won't change that.
[trusting] I'm sure they had their reasons. I'll ask what they were, kindly.

cheerful.li: [clear] Refused, but it's a lovely clear evening, and I'm going to enjoy it anyway.
[clear] They said no. The sky said yes. I'll go with the sky.

gloomy.li: [night] Awake again, turning it over. No is such a short word.
[night] Couldn't sleep. Kept hearing them say no.

plain.li: [night] Did it by lamplight, after everyone else had gone to bed. Nobody will know until morning.
[night] Couldn't sleep, so I got up and saw to it myself.
